S1_lever.interpretation: Native nominal neutral lever is the sole visible S1 geometry; superseded tilted proxy is absent. Lever emerges approximately 9.704 mm above the panel. Bushing ends 0.296 mm below the outer surface under the existing board seat assumption. Keep source body/lever and assembly pose; actual seating and full throw clearance remain unqualified.

limits: Only presentation skirt, knob and pointer objects are proposed to move; labels, native PCB models, board/case/panel transforms and full source dimensions remain fixed. No scene or project was saved or edited.
The current knob proxies are solid envelopes, not modeled hollow bores. Internal clearance uses an explicitly assumed 0.5 mm roof; it is not a vendor bore/grip or fitted-seat measurement.
Nominal insertion is shaft tip minus knob bottom along the panel normal. It assumes coaxial placement and gives envelope overlap, not retained torque or pull-off strength.
S2 retains approximately 5.504 mm nominal engagement, about 0.92 times its 6 mm shaft diameter. This supports a plausible visual seat, but no vendor minimum grip is established.

EVU and Alpha proposed overlap extends approximately 2.304 mm below the published flatted portion into the round shaft envelope. The unknown underside entry/recess and D-socket length prevent claiming exact shaft fit.
Switch cap socket, actual engagement and stroke are unknown. Solid proxy overlaps are expected construction simplifications, not evidence of compatible snap fit.
S1 remains neutral; no complete swept throw or panel-tolerance analysis was performed.
